name: linux-pam

commands.command:
mkdir build &&
cd build &&

meson setup ..        \
  --prefix=/usr       \
  --buildtype=release \
  -D docdir=/usr/share/doc/Linux-PAM-{version}

install -v -m755 -d /etc/pam.d &&
cat > /etc/pam.d/other << "EOF"
auth     required       pam_deny.so
account  required       pam_deny.so
password required       pam_deny.so
session  required       pam_deny.so
EOF

install -vdm755 /etc/pam.d &&
cat > /etc/pam.d/system-account << "EOF"
# Begin /etc/pam.d/system-account

account   required    pam_unix.so

# End /etc/pam.d/system-account
EOF

cat > /etc/pam.d/system-auth << "EOF"
# Begin /etc/pam.d/system-auth

auth      required    pam_unix.so

# End /etc/pam.d/system-auth
EOF

cat > /etc/pam.d/system-session << "EOF"
# Begin /etc/pam.d/system-session

session   required    pam_unix.so

# End /etc/pam.d/system-session
EOF

cat > /etc/pam.d/system-password << "EOF"
# Begin /etc/pam.d/system-password

password  required    pam_unix.so       yescrypt shadow try_first_pass

# End /etc/pam.d/system-password
EOF

cat > /etc/pam.d/other << "EOF"
# Begin /etc/pam.d/other

auth        required        pam_warn.so
auth        required        pam_deny.so
account     required        pam_warn.so
account     required        pam_deny.so
password    required        pam_warn.so
password    required        pam_deny.so
session     required        pam_warn.so
session     required        pam_deny.so

# End /etc/pam.d/other
EOF

description: Linux-PAM provides Pluggable Authentication Modules used by the system administrator to control application authentication.

kernel_requirements.required_for: pam_loginuid.so when systemd is rebuilt with PAM support

installed_descriptions.name: faillock
installed_descriptions.description: Displays and modifies authentication failure record files

installed_descriptions.name: pam_namespace_helper
installed_descriptions.description: Configures a private namespace for a user session

installed_descriptions.name: pam_timestamp_check
installed_descriptions.description: Checks whether the default PAM timestamp is valid

installed_descriptions.name: pwhistory_helper
installed_descriptions.description: Transfers password hashes from passwd or shadow to opasswd

installed_descriptions.name: unix_chkpwd
installed_descriptions.description: Helper used by pam_unix to verify a user's password
